```{r, fig.align='center', out.width='70%'}
meme_get("TwoButtonsAnxiety") %>%
  meme_text_buttons(
    "UNDERSTAND\nTHE CODE",
    "JUST GET\nIT TO RUN",
    size=15
    ) %>%
  meme_text_top("ME DURING EVERY R ASSIGNMENT", size=22) %>%
  meme_text_bottom("WHY CAN'T I HAVE BOTH?", size=22)
```

## Interpretation

1. What I like most about the class is learning the skills to complete complex coding. I feel like I've gained a lot of confidence in my ability to navigate R successfully. I also appreciate the ability to complete projects in groups because I can learn from others and better my understanding of the assignment.

2. What I like least about the class is the ambiguity surrounding how group work should be divided. I feel that it can be difficult to equally split up our contributions in some projects.
